rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy holds liability insurance (toiminnan vastuuvakuutus) with cover of EUR 2,000,000, above the required minimum for this contract.
Visakoivu Oy's equity ratio in its most recent financial statements was 35.2%, above the required minimum for this contract.
Visakoivu Oy employs 48 professionals in its electrical (sahko) discipline, above the required minimum for this contract.
Visakoivu Oy holds a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate, current at the time of this quotation.

Visakoivu Oy does not hold the information-security certification required under this clause at the time of this quotation. This is an eligibility requirement Visakoivu genuinely cannot meet, and the company is submitting this response as a no-bid on that basis.

The proposed HVAC (LVI) maintenance agreement covers scheduled inspection and servicing of air-handling and ventilation equipment, filter changes, and a documented log of measurements and findings at each visit.

Visakoivu Oy will include a site-specific occupational safety plan for the facility, addressing task-specific hazards, permit-to-work procedures and site induction requirements for its own and subcontracted personnel.

Visakoivu Oy's fire-protection maintenance regime for the facility covers periodic testing of smoke detection systems, functional testing of fire dampers, and inspection and testing of emergency lighting, in accordance with the applicable regulatory intervals for each system type.
Visakoivu Oy offers a standard warranty period on equipment installed under this contract, in line with the relevant manufacturer's own warranty terms for that equipment.

Visakoivu Oy segregates waste by category (mixed, hazardous, metal, WEEE) generated during works at the facility, and disposes of it through licensed waste contractors in accordance with applicable environmental regulations.

Visakoivu Oy maintains service continuity through documented handover procedures, cross-trained backup technicians for each discipline, and an overlap period between an outgoing and incoming technician on any given site.

Visakoivu Oy maintains stock of common spare parts for the installed building systems through its regional supplier network; parts not held in stock are sourced with a standard delivery time of five working days, or sooner where the fault affects a safety-critical system.
Visakoivu Oy holds NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management system certification and manages waste segregation, hazardous-substance handling and spill prevention across all works under that system.

Visakoivu Oy's personnel are briefed on the buyer's access-control and site-security procedures before starting work at the facility, including any additional site-access and escort requirements specific to the data centre, and comply with these procedures throughout the contract.

Visakoivu Oy proposes a limitation of liability capped at the contract's annual value, in line with its liability and professional indemnity insurance cover, excluding wilful misconduct or gross negligence.
All prices in this quotation are quoted in euros, as required by Section 7.
Visakoivu Oy does not propose a retention on invoices under this maintenance contract.
Visakoivu Oy is prepared to discuss a volume-based discount structure on the framework agreement's overall value at the time of contract finalisation.

Visakoivu Oy operates an environmental management system certified to NMSB 74210:2015, covering waste segregation, hazardous-substance handling, spill prevention and monitoring of environmental performance across its operations; a description of this system will be enclosed with the quotation.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose a certificate from its pension insurance provider confirming that its pension insurance payments (elakevakuutusmaksut) are up to date.
Maintenance pricing in this quotation is based on price per square metre, consistent with the format required in Section 7.3.
This quotation is submitted as a single PDF file and is not password-protected.
Prices in this quotation are quoted in EUR per square metre per year, not per month, as required.

Visakoivu Oy proposes service-level targets differentiated by fault category for the facility: safety-critical faults, including faults affecting mechanical or electrical plant supporting the data centre, receive an on-site response under the standby arrangement described in the response to A.3; other reactive faults are attended during the next working day; non-urgent items are scheduled into the next routine visit.
Visakoivu Oy's building automation specialists work with standard building-management protocols including BACnet and Modbus, and confirm compatibility with the buyer's system.

Visakoivu Oy operates a standby (paivystys) arrangement covering hours outside normal working hours, staffed by on-call technicians; fault reports are acknowledged promptly and prioritised by category as described in the response to A.1.

Visakoivu Oy will operate an annual visit calendar for the facility, with a standard task list for each visit and a signed visit report issued to the buyer confirming completion of the tasks carried out.
Visakoivu Oy is open to agreeing a bonus/malus arrangement linked to the service levels in Section 4, to be defined jointly with the buyer during contract finalisation.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose CVs of the key personnel proposed for delivery of this contract, drawn from its LVI, electrical and building automation teams.
Visakoivu Oy will include a list of subcontractors, if any are used for this contract, as Liite 3.

no_bid_reason: M005: Visakoivu Oy does not hold a valid NMSB 73710 information security certificate, required under clause 3.5 of this invitation because the site includes remote management of the building automation system. All other eligibility requirements (3.1-3.4) are met, but this single certification gap makes Visakoivu ineligible under the tender's own terms; Visakoivu is declining to bid on this basis rather than submit a quotation it cannot honour.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy has reviewed Datakeskus Silta Oy's request for quotation (DKS-2026-007) for technical maintenance services at its Jyvaskyla facility. Visakoivu Oy is not submitting a quotation for this contract; the reason is set out below.
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy is a Jyvaskyla-based technical and property services company founded in 1994, providing LVI, electrical, building automation and property maintenance services to public and private clients across Central Finland.
